## Technology Stack

- Static site: HTML + CSS + Vanilla JavaScript
- Hosted: GitHub Pages
- Data: JSON files under /data/ (team.json, events.json, gallery.json)
- CTF flag verification: SHA-256 hashed flags via Web Crypto API (no raw flags exposed)
- No build step required — fully static
